citations.claim: First violating step: total energy has drifted to -620.4 from E0 -483.4 during close encounter, exceeding tolerance
One step before, energy already drifted to -577.4 showing error growth during deep close approach distance 0.35
Two steps before, energy still -483.5 conserved while separation larger, proving failure coincides with periapsis

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.0176755 to 0.005 with all else identical; finer integration resolves close encounter and energy stays conserved

explanation: Two heavy bodies (~17,18 Msun, G~4.73) on head-on orbits undergo deep close encounter (0.39->0.35 separation at steps 22-23). Adaptive substeps (13-16 per step) insufficient for strong acceleration/velocity; leapfrog phase error injects energy: -483.5 at step22 to -577.4 at step23 to -620.4 at step24. Smaller dt removes failure, confirming integrator-accuracy cause, not force-model error. Momentum remains conserved.
vision_note: Two blue bodies converge into an extremely tight, nearly overlapping encounter from step 21 to 23, with short trails indicating fast close motion. By step 24 they remain in touching contact as a tight pair rather than passing through cleanly.
